messages:
Zoe Kim: Quick decision needed for trace permalink behavior in the compact list: persistent pin icon on each row vs only in overflow menu? Mock: https://figma.com/file/permalink-choices
Arjun Mehta: Persistent icon is faster to act on. Overflow keeps the rows cleaner though. Tradeoff = discoverability vs density.
Claire Holt: Could be hybrid: persistent icon only in expanded rows or when density is low. Also allow a user preference (show permalinks).
Ben Ortiz: If persistent, clicking should copy link by default (most users paste into tickets). But must still offer "Open in new tab" in overflow.
Zoe Kim: Copy-by-click feels good, but we need clear feedback, e.g., small inline check + tooltip update "Link copied" for 1.2s.
a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: icon must be a real button with aria-label like "Copy permalink for trace 0xabc". Announce copy with aria-live: "Trace permalink copied to clipboard." Ensure hit area >= 44px.
Arjun Mehta: For keyboard, focused permalink -> Enter opens mini menu (Copy / Open / Export). Space could perform the primary action (copy). Document in keyboard help.
Claire Holt: Microcopy: keep verbs first: "Copy permalink", "Open trace", "Export (JSON)". Also add tooltip: "Copy permalink — includes active filters" so users know what link contains.
Ben Ortiz: Implementation detail: permalink should include selected frame id as param (e.g., ?frame=3) but if URL too long fallback to short link service. Server-side short ids is fine.
Zoe Kim: Export choices: CSV for frames table, JSON for full trace. Default export modal should preselect CSV when in table view and JSON when in trace detail.
a11y-bot: Export modal accessibility: role="dialog", trap focus, close button aria-label, and announce "Download started" in aria-live when export begins.
Claire Holt: Edge case: mobile clipboard APIs are flaky. If copy fails, open a small dialog with the link preselected so they can long-press-copy. Provide helpful toast: "Tap to copy link."
Arjun Mehta: Analytics: track copy vs open vs export clicks, and whether users toggle persistent permalinks. That informs defaults.
Ben Ortiz: Prototyping note: I'll add a ghost-style persistent icon that dims in high-density mode and becomes full on hover.
Zoe Kim: Action items: @Ben prototype icon states, @Claire update microcopy and tooltip text, @Arjun draft keyboard spec, @a11y-bot produce aria snippets. I'll update Figma and post link when done. :thumbsup:
